{{Top|leg}}
'''Pyroliosis''', or '''[[Lung/Legends|Firelung]]''' was a fatal respiratory disease caused by the inhaling of the dust of the mineral [[zenium]], which was mined by the convicts on [[Oovo IV/Legends|Oovo IV]]. It ate the body from the inside out, and destroyed the respiratory systems of [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoids]] like [[Acid/Legends|acid]]. It was extremely painful.
